title: Kanlaon Volcano emits ash on Sunday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Kanlaon Volcano emitted ash on Sunday morning following a moderately explosive eruption the previous day, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Based on Phivolcs’ footage, the ash emission occurred at 5:15 a.m. “The event generated a grayish plume that rose 600 meters above the summit crater before drifting generally west, as visually recorded by the Mansalanao Observation Station (VKMN), Upper Pantao Observation Station (VKUP), and Canlaon City Observation Station (KVO-CC) IP cameras,” Phivolcs said in a Facebook post.
